scope: All desktop H5 pages; min-width: 1024px, hover: hover, pointer: fine. Football and morph are confined to the login artwork/divider.
implementation: Native PNG cursors at rest. Busy/progress use six fixed segment contours whose dark fills chase clockwise in 1200ms. Orange accent is stationary at the upper right. Reduced motion or image failure retains a visible static native cursor.

integration.importStyle: H5 AccountBoundary mounts and cleans up mountCursorSkin once for login and product pages. Shared App and WeChat boundary are unchanged.
integration.disabledControls: Native disabled, disabled attribute, aria-disabled=true, existing Taro disabled class and no-drop show the coral unavailable skin; disabling or re-enabling a hovered control updates without pointer movement. aria-busy=true takes priority over disabled while submitting.
